raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely adopted an “earliest-by-title” heuristic and recorded Kingdom of Rock as a 2007 release based on unverified hints (e.g., Apple Music/Last.fm) without confirming via reliable sources or disambiguating by artist. This deviated from the stated plan to verify dates (Discogs/AllMusic/Wikipedia/official sites) and would lead to concluding Kingdom of Rock came earlier, contradicting the correct outcome that Was I The Wave? (2011) predates the notable Kingdom of Rock (2015).
